name: separate-crate-e2e-cli-reachable-scope
body: Limit: this e2e pins the CLI-reachable planned-node realization contract only — the splice_cached placeholder-masking corner paired with location-based delta selection (reachable solely by hand-editing plan JSONL) is deliberately not exercised here. Upgrade if that corner becomes CLI-reachable: extend this test (or a sibling) to drive a planned placeholder against a cached, unchanged declaration and assert realization.
